definitions: A common male given name of Greek origin, meaning 'crown' or 'garland'.
The first Christian martyr, stoned to death in Jerusalem, as recorded in the Acts of the Apostles.
Several saints, kings, and other notable historical figures have borne the name Stephen.
examples: Stephen was late for the meeting.
Saint Stephen's Day is celebrated on 26 December.
King Stephen reigned in England from 1135 to 1154.
